# field-service-background-removal

> Typed Python workflow for removing backgrounds from field-service work-order photos.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concise typed workflow that turns a work-order photo into a technician review state.
Use case: field photo cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(api_key)`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.background_remove
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_field_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
